mentor.diagnosis: You picked a term that belongs to a neighbour of the one described. Objective 1.2 (fundamental security concepts) contains families of terms that sound interchangeable and are separated by one attribute each.
mentor.rule: When two terms in the same family feel interchangeable, do not memorise both definitions. Find the single attribute the exam uses to tell them apart, and learn that attribute.
